sentences.text: The evidence does not show the KFS pre-payment charge, so the KFS and the home loan agreement cannot be confirmed to state the same charge from the materials provided. (E8, E14, E16)

The home loan agreement evidence is inconsistent on the pre-payment charge, with one version stating 2% of principal outstanding and another version stating 3% of principal outstanding. (E4, E5, E6, E7)

missing.searched: Reviewed the provided KFS evidence for any stated pre-payment charge; only the KFS title/definition and disclosure requirement were found, not the charge amount.
